basic.name: Energy Wave
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% Magical DMG.

default.name: Dark Ripple
desc: (Magical DMG) Deals 70% [AoE DMG] to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target and inflicts [⊘Passive Skills] and [⊘Reaction Skills], lasting for 2 turns.

skills.name: Field
desc: (Aura) Decreases [AoE DMG] taken by all allies within 3 tiles around the character by 25%.

skills.name: Corruption - Extra
desc: （Passive）At the end of the action, applies 2 random [Lv. 2 Attribute Debuffs] to all enemies within each [Luxite Minefield] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Luxite Attraction
desc: （Support）Select a target on the field that has [Luxite Minefield]. Knocks back enemies within a cross-shaped area of 3 tiles around the target (5 tiles wide) by 2 tiles toward the center. If the caster has [Grand Feast EX] and it is available to cast, cast it immediately.

（Attached Passive）When Alert is activated at the end of the action, grants an Aura effect: Enemies within [Luxite Minefield] Alert range gain [Piercing Vulnerability 2], [▼DMG 2], and [▼Piercing DMG 2].

skills.name: Grand Banquet
desc: (Debuff) Inflicts 2 stacks of [Temporary Blast Lock-on] and 2 random [Level 2 Debuff] on all enemies within the area of [Luxite Minefield] for 2 turns. Then gains [▲ATK II] and [▲DMG Reduction II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Defense (AoE)
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active AoE attack, reduces the DMG taken by 40%.

skills.name: Martyr's Blast Elegy
desc: (Reaction) DMG taken is reduced by 20%. When attacked by a target with [Blast Lock-on], DMG taken is reduced by an additional 20%. When defeated, deals 30% piercing DMG to targets within 2 tiles and all targets in battle with [Blast Lock-on].

skills.name: Battle Deployment
desc: (Choice) Selects and casts either [Follow Orders] or [Form Up]. Casting either skill puts this skill on CD.

skills.name: Pass the Parcel
desc: (Passive) Increases piercing DMG by 30%; if the target has [Blast Lock-on], additionally increases it by 30%. When an enemy with [Blast Lock-on] is defeated, inflicts [Blast Lock-on] on a random enemy within [Luxite Minefield] who does not have [Blast Lock-on].

skills.name: Silencing Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals piercing DMG equal to 60% of M.ATK. When attacking an enemy with [Injured], inflicts [⊘Active Skill] before attacking for 2 turns.

skills.name: Princess's Grace
desc: （Basic Attack）Select a target and deal 60% Piercing DMG to enemies within 1 tile of the target, then apply 1 stack of [Temporary Blast Lock-on] to the target.

skills.name: Concussive Tuning
desc: (Passive) The first 2 triggers of [Luxite Minefield] each round deal 30% less DMG, but targets that trigger Alert are also interrupted (has no effect if the target is immune to interruption).

skills.name: Desireless Meditation
desc: (Passive) At the start of an action, gains 4 [Faith]. At the end of the action, if no Attack Skill was used during this action turn, restores 1 Energy and gains [▲P.DEF 3] and [▲M.DEF 3] for 2 turns.

basic.name: Straight Shot
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Hallowed Judgment
desc: (Physical DMG) Can be cast with at least 5 stacks of [Clarity]. Skill prepare time: 2 turns.

Prepares until the next 1 character's turn starts, then triggers the following effect: Deals [Single-Target DMG] equal to 35% × the number of [Clarity] stacks to the first enemy in each column of the 5*6 area in the target direction, then removes all [Clarity].
When attacking, each stack of [Clarity] allows the attack to ignore 3% of the target's DEF and increases the character's Crit by 3%.

skills.name: Canonical Prayer
desc: (Support) Gains 2 stacks of [Conviction] and 2 stacks of [Clarity].
[Associated Passive] Effect: After actively using [Basic Attack], if the character has 3 NRG, consumes it and triggers this skill's effect again.

skills.name: Chain Discipline
desc: (Physical DMG) Single-target attack. Deals 135% DMG, then ricochets to another enemy within 3 tiles of the target. Can deal 135% DMG up to 2 additional times in total.
If there is no suitable new target when ricocheting, deals the remaining instances of DMG to the last target.

skills.name: Luminary Resonance
desc: (Support) Causes all other targets orbited by [Luminary], excluding the character, to trigger the corresponding effects in sequence:
For the designated target and the nearest hostile character within 3 tiles of it, an ally of [Cleia] attacks the enemy with an available [Basic Attack], dealing half DMG.
If there is no eligible character within the target's range, [Cleia] deals DMG equal to 50% of her P.ATK to the target (if an enemy) or heals the target by that amount (if an ally).
[Associated Passive] Effect: When [Fair Judgement] is triggered, increases DMG dealt and healing by 40%.

skills.name: M.DEF Command
desc: (Aura) Increases M.DEF by 30% for other allies within 2 tiles around the character.

skills.name: Patrol Sanctuary
desc: (Reaction) At the start of the turn, a target orbited by [Luminary] gains the corresponding effect:
If the target is an ally, gains [DMG Reduction II] and [Piercing DMG Reduction II] for 2 turns.
If the target is an enemy, inflicts [Blind] and [Dazzled] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Protection of Light
desc: (Reaction) When actively attacked by a single target, reduces DMG taken by 30%. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Prescient Insight
desc: (Passive) [Patrol Sanctuary] additionally gains the following effect: Before combat, a target surrounded by [Luminary] additionally triggers the corresponding effect of [Patrol Sanctuary] on both sides.
When this skill effect applies to an enemy, additionally inflicts [▼ATK V] for 1 turn. CD: 4 turns for each target after triggering.

skills.name: Strategic Strike
desc: (Passive) At the start of the turn or after any action, if the character has the skill [Hallowed Judgment] and it is not on CD, gains 8 stacks of [Clarity]. Can be triggered up to 1 time in battle.
At the start of every battle round that is a multiple of 4, resets the trigger count of this effect.

skills.name: Chastise
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals 80% physical DMG and gains 1 stack of [Conviction] before attacking.
This skill can be cast on enemies around a target orbited by [Luminary], within 3 tiles (changes with the skill's range).

skills.name: Charged Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% physical DMG and increases the DMG of the next skill by 15%.

skills.name: Devout Faith
desc: (Passive) When the character's [Piety] is greater than or equal to 10, increases ATK by 15% and DEF by 30%.

skills.name: Blessing
desc: (Support) [Instant]. Single-target healing. Restores 25% HP. Before healing, if the target is [Unharmed], additionally grants [▲DMG II] and [▲M.DEF II] for 2 turns.
If the target belongs to the〈Papal States〉faction, additionally increases their [Piety] by 5.

basic.name: Straight Shot
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Knock-Back Shot
desc: (Physical DMG) Deals 135% DMG to 1 enemy within a cross-shaped range around the character and knocks them back by 2 tiles.

skills.name: Blindside Assault
desc: (Physical DMG) Performs a single-target attack, dealing 50% DMG; then deals 90% AoE DMG to all enemies within the 1*4-tile area directly ahead.

Has [Attached Passive], which has the following effect: When attacking enemies with [Priority Mark], increases ATK by 20%, Crit by 30%, and Crit DMG by 15%; when attacking an enemy from behind, doubles the Crit and Crit DMG increases.

skills.name: Resolution of Daybreak
desc: (Physical DMG) [Rally Command]. Performs a single-target attack, dealing 150% DMG, ignoring [Assisting Cover], inflicting [▼Move II] for 2 turns, and knocking the target back 2 tiles;
For every 1 [Buff] or 2 [Debuffs] the target has, performs 1 follow-up attack that deals 10% DMG, up to 5 follow-up attacks.
After attacking, removes 1 NRG from the target.

skills.name: Smokescreen Guerrilla
desc: (Support) [Instant]. Teleports to the target [Empty Tile] and turns the tile into [Smoke] for 2 turns. Gains 1 [Dodge] lasting until the start of the next 2 turns, [▲ATK III], and [Shadowstride] for 3 turns.
Cannot be cast again while under [Shadowstride].

skills.name: Displaced Escort
desc: (Physical DMG) [Instant]. Selects an enemy while ignoring obstacles and knocks them 5 tiles toward the character. If a collision occurs, inflicts [Stunned] on the target for 1 turn. Before attacking, reduces collision DMG taken by the character by 100%.
Then teleports in front of the target and deals 40% DMG. After attacking, gains 1 [Dodge] lasting until the start of the next 2 turns and [▲ATK III] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Fleeing Hare
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack, the DMG taken is decreased by 8%. After being attacked, the character gains [▲Move II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Disruption Tactics
desc: (Reaction) When hit by a single-target attack, if the character does not have [Dodge], performs [Preempt] and inflicts [Blind] on the attacker for 1 turn; when hit by an AoE attack, performs [Preempt] and inflicts [Dazzled] on the attacker for 1 turn. Preempt effects can trigger up to 2 times per round.

After entering [Prowl Form], gains the following additional effect: After being actively attacked, teleports behind the attacker, [Strikes Back] for [piercing DMG] equal to 40% of P.ATK, and gains 1 [Dodge] for 2 turns. Can trigger up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Intimidation Tactics
desc: (Physical DMG) [Instant]. Selects a tile and deals 30% DMG to all enemies within 1 ring of the target, dispels 2 [Buffs], and inflicts [Blind], [Dazzled], and [▼ATK II] for 1 turn, then inflicts [Priority Mark].

skills.name: Traceless Shadow
desc: (Support) Gains 1 [Dodge] for 1 turn. Upon a successful [dodge], teleports behind the attacker's back, dealing 100% Physical DMG, and gains [dodge] again for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shield-Break Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% physical DMG and gains [Shield Break I] before attacking.

skills.name: Stringlight
desc: (Basic Attack) Performs a single-target attack, dealing 70% physical DMG. If the enemy is within 2 tiles, additionally knocks them back 2 tiles. After attacking, restores 1 NRG.
When attacking, if the character and target are in a straight line, additionally deals 30% AoE physical DMG to all enemies within the 1*3-tile area directly ahead.

skills.name: Field Protocol
desc: (Passive) Increases SPD by 50. During the first battle round, additionally increases SPD by 50. While [Healthy], reduces DMG taken by 20%.

skills.name: Battle Fever
desc: (Passive) After initiating an Active Attack, the character takes 15% less DMG. Dealing Crit DMG additionally decreases DMG taken by 25% for 1 turn.

basic.name: Energy Wave - Piercing
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 60% of M.ATK as [piercing DMG].

default.name: Rift Bolt
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects any enemy in a cross-shaped range of 4 tiles of the character, deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 50% of M.ATK, and knocks back the target by 2 tiles.
When casting this skill by triggering the [Casting Anchor] effect, the knockback direction is based on the [Manifest Rift] passed through, and increases Piercing DMG dealt by 20%.
After casting the skill, the next time this skill or [Starfall Genesis] is cast, NRG cost is reduced by 2, DMG is doubled, and DMG to the initial target is additionally increased to 3 times.
Gains [Auxiliary Passive]. Effect: The distance-based ATK bonus in the character's [Trait] is doubled.

skills.name: Inner Light
desc: (Support) [Instant] Selects 1 ally target, then restores 1 NRG to all allies within 3 tiles around the target. The character can not be targeted.

skills.name: Ex Nihilo
desc: (Passive) The initial available uses of the skill [Summon - Manifest Rift] are increased by 1.

skills.name: Wayfinder
desc: (Aura) Before all allies in battle with [Temporal Drift] cast a skill, they gain [Co-Attack], [Co-Defense], and [Immune to Attribute Debuffs] for 2 turns.
All "Dimension Traveler" allies in battle: increases ATK by 10% and DEF by 20%; After using [Rewind] or [Void Step], increases ATK and DEF by 15%, lasting until the end of the battle.

skills.name: Starfall Genesis
desc: (Piercing DMG) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 75% of M.ATK and bounces to another enemy within 3 tiles of the target.
When bouncing, if no enemy is within range, bounces to a [Manifest Rift] within range instead (does not count toward the bounce limit).
For each 1 [Manifest Rift], can bounce 1 additional time, up to 5; each bounce increases [Piercing DMG] by 10%, up to 50%.
When casting this skill by triggering the [Casting Anchor] effect, the first bounces between all other [Manifest Rifts] in battle before bouncing into a [Manifest Rift] near the target.
Each time a [Manifest Rift] is afflicted with [Void Return], the next cast of this skill triggers maximum DMG increase and bounce count increase effects. Casts can accumulate.

skills.name: Defense (AoE)
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active AoE attack, reduces the DMG taken by 40%.

skills.name: Stellar Ripple
desc: (Reaction) Gains an aura. Effect: Reduces final DMG taken by 15% for all allies in battle with [Temporal Drift].
At the end of the character's turn, heals all allies affected by this aura for 40% of M.ATK, then dispels 2 [Debuffs].

When the character is defeated, if a [Manifest Rift] is in battle (without [Void Return]), triggers [Unyielding] and afflicts the closest [Manifest Rift] with [Void Return]. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Rift Undulate
desc: (Decision) Can be used when [Manifest Rift] is in battle. Selects to use [Displacement] or [Warp Jump].
Gains [Auxiliary Passive]. Effect: When [Manifest Rift] is afflicted with [Void Return], [Finalter] advances the [Fate Dial] by 3.

skills.name: Concerto of Worlds
desc: (Passive) [Manifest Rift] gains [Rally Response]. Effect: Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 30% of [Finalter]'s M.ATK to all enemies within a cross-shaped range of 4 tiles. Each [Manifest Rift] can trigger this up to 1 time per round.
The character's exclusive attack skills gain the [Rally Command] tag.
When [Manifest Rift] is afflicted with [Void Return], triggers its [Rally Response].

skills.name: Course Correction
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 60% of M.ATK; when actively used, advances the [Fate Dial] by 3.
If no [Manifest Rift] is in battle or all [Manifest Rifts] are afflicted with [Void Return], the effect changes to advancing by 6.

skills.name: Dispelling Strike - Piercing
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 60% of M.ATK and dispels 2 [Buffs] from the target.

skills.name: Invulnerable - Extra
desc: (Support) Grants the target [DMG Reduction IV], [Mind's Eye], and [Immunity to Disrupt] for 3 turns.

skills.name: First Aid
desc: (Healing) Single-target healing. Heals 80% HP.

basic.name: Energy Wave
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% Magical DMG.

default.name: Endless Winter
desc: (Piercing Attack) [Damp Cold] Selects a tile, affecting characters in a horizontal row of 3 tiles of the target:
If an enemy, deals 60% [Ice] piercing AoE DMG, then inflicts [▼Move I] (lasting 2 turns) and [Ice Coffin] (lasting 1 turn).
If an ally, grants [Frostblessing Seal], lasting until the start of their next turn.

skills.name: Mending Litany
desc: (Passive) After actively casting a skill on 1 other ally, additionally heals them for 30% of M.ATK.
At the end of the turn, heals the other ally with the lowest HP percentage within 3 tiles of the character for 20% of M.ATK.

skills.name: Glacial Procession
desc: (Piercing DMG) [Damp Cold] Selects a tile within a cross-shaped range of 4 tiles of the character, affecting characters within a cross-shaped area of 2 tiles (3 tiles wide) of the target:
If an enemy, deals 60% [Ice] piercing AoE DMG, then inflicts [▼Move II] (lasting 2 turns) and [Ice Coffin] (lasting 1 turn).
If an ally, grants [Frostblessing Seal], lasting until the start of their next turn.
After using this skill, the character gains [Grace Obscured] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Wither's Omen
desc: (Support) Grants allies [▲ATK III] and [Wither's Omen] for 2 turns.
If the target is on a [Frosty] or [Permafrost Trench] tile, additionally heals them for 30% of M.ATK.
When carrying the skill [Where Fate Treads], this skill additionally grants the target [Frostblessing Seal] (without the [▼SPD IV] debuff effect), lasting until the start of their next turn.
When carrying the skill [Glacial Procession], this skill additionally deals piercing AoE DMG equal to 30% of M.ATK to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target.

skills.name: Grace of Goddess
desc: (Reaction) Reduces piercing DMG taken by 15%; when actively attacked, reduces DMG taken by 15%.
When in [Injured] state, performs [Daunting Preempt], granting the character [Frostblessing Seal] (lasting until the start of the next turn). Effect CD: 3 turns.

skills.name: Protection of Ice
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack from an enemy with [▼Move], the DMG taken is decreased by 30%.

skills.name: Hear the Oracle
desc: (Passive) At the start of the turn, recovers 1 NRG and must select 1 skill from [Censure], [Divine Benediction], and [Orison] to use, or perform [Standby]; then triggers [Act Again].
Each skill can only be selected 1 time. After all skills have been used, resets [Hear the Oracle], allowing them to be selected again.

skills.name: Where Fate Treads
desc: (Healing) Selects a tile. Heals all allies within 2 tiles of the target for 60% of M.ATK, grants [Frostblessing Seal] (lasting until the start of their next turn) and 2 random [Level 2 Attribute Buffs] (lasting 2 turns), then dispels 2 [Debuffs].

skills.name: Winter's Verdict
desc: (Basic Attack) [Damp Cold] Single-target attack. Deals [Ice] piercing DMG equal to 40% of M.ATK, inflicts [▼Move I] (lasting 2 turns). If the target already has the [▼Move] series, the effect changes to [Ice Coffin] (lasting 1 turn).

skills.name: Merciful Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% magical DMG and increases the effect of the next healing skill by 15%, lasting for 2 turns.

skills.name: All Roads to Tundra
desc: (Passive) After an active attack, turns tiles within the skill's range into [Frosty]. At the end of the turn, turns all tiles within 2 tiles into [Frosty] for 2 turns.
Gains an aura. Effect: Grants all allies in battle the [All Roads to Tundra] effect.

basic.name: Energy Wave
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% Magical DMG.

default.name: Marked!
desc: (Support) [Instant]. Inflicts [Lucky Audience] on any target. Can be used up to 2 times per round (up to 2 characters with [Lucky Audience] can exist in battle; repeated application removes the earliest one).
Gains [Rally Response], effect: triggers [Lucky Audience] effects in battle early. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
Gains [Auxiliary Passive], effect: when [Surprise Encore] triggers a [Lucky Audience] effect, recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Crackle Crackle BOOM!
desc: (Magical DMG) [Rally Command] Selects a tile to deal 130% DMG to all enemies within 3 tiles of the target and inflict [Party Favor] (lasting 2 turns), then prepares for 1 turn before dealing 65% DMG to enemies in the area; during preparation, enemies in the area are affected by [▼Move II] and [Vulnerable II]. Before attacking, increases ATK by 20%.

enh.name: Crackle Crackle BOOM!
desc: (Magical DMG) [Rally Command] Selects a tile to deal 150% DMG to all enemies within 3 tiles of the target and inflict [Party Favor] (lasting 2 turns), then prepares for 1 turn before dealing 75% DMG to enemies in the area; during preparation, enemies in the area are affected by [▼Move II] and [Vulnerable II]. Before attacking, increases ATK by 20%.

skills.name: Center Stage, Now!
desc: (Magical DMG) [Rally Command] Selects any target and teleports to any tile within 3 tiles of the target; then deals 100% DMG to all enemies within a 2-tile radius of the target and draws them in by 2 tiles toward the center horizontal row; before attacking, inflicts [▼M.DEF II] for 2 turns.

enh.name: Center Stage, Now!
desc: (Magical DMG) [Rally Command] Selects any target and teleports to any tile within 4 tiles of the target; then deals 120% DMG to all enemies within a 2-tile radius of the target and draws them in by 2 tiles toward the center horizontal row; before attacking, inflicts [▼M.DEF II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Core - Create
desc: (Support) Selects an [Empty Tile] to summon [Inspiration Core], inheriting 30% of the character's basic HP. When [Inspiration Core] already exists in battle, skill switches to [Core - Warp].
[Auxiliary Passive], effect: At the start of the battle, automatically summons [Inspiration Core] without consuming NRG.

enh.name: Core - Create
desc: (Support) [Instant] Selects an [Empty Tile] to summon [Inspiration Core], inheriting 30% of the character's basic HP. When [Inspiration Core] already exists in battle, skill switches to [Core - Warp].
[Auxiliary Passive], effect: At the start of the battle, automatically summons [Inspiration Core] without consuming NRG.

skills.name: The Show Must Go On!
desc: (Decision) Selects to use [Grand Tour] or [Spotlight Solo].
While this skill is equipped, [Inspiration Core] will not automatically consume [Inspiration Gauge] to attack at the end of its turn.

enh.name: The Show Must Go On!
desc: (Decision) Selects to use [Grand Tour] or [Spotlight Solo].
While this skill is equipped, [Inspiration Core] will not automatically consume [Inspiration Gauge] to attack at the end of its turn.

skills.name: Super Boom Boom Boom!
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 70% magical DMG to all enemies within a 1-tile radius of the target.

enh.name: Super Boom Boom Boom!
desc: (Basic Attack) [Rally Command] Deals 70% magical DMG to all enemies within a 1-tile radius of the target.

skills.name: Fantasia Resonance
desc: (Passive) All other allies within 4 tiles of the [Inspiration Core] gain [▲ATK II], [▲P.DEF II], and [▲M.DEF II]; at the end of the [Summoner]'s turn, if within range, recovers an additional 1 NRG.

Gains [Rally Response], effect: the [Summoner] immediately deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 40% of M.ATK to the [Inspiration Core] (also triggered when other allies attack the [Inspiration Core]); this DMG has the [Resonance - The Magician] effect. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.

enh.name: Fantasia Resonance
desc: (Passive) All other allies within 6 tiles of the [Inspiration Core] gain [▲ATK II], [▲P.DEF II], and [▲M.DEF II]; at the end of the [Summoner]'s turn, if within range, recovers an additional 1 NRG.

Gains [Rally Response], effect: the [Summoner] immediately deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 50% of M.ATK to the [Inspiration Core] (also triggered when other allies attack the [Inspiration Core]); this DMG has the [Resonance - The Magician] effect. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.

basic.name: Slash
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 80% of P.ATK.

default.name: Mauling Sweep
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects a direction, deals 80% [AoE DMG] to the first enemy in each column within a 3×2 area directly in front, knocks back 2 tiles, depletes 2 NRG, and inflicts [⊘Active Skills] for 1 turn.
After attacking, recovers 3 NRG.

skills.name: Quaking Roar
desc: (Piercing DMG) [NRG Cascade]. Selects an [Empty Tile] within a cross-shaped range of the character, performs [Charge] and deals [Piercing DMG] equal to (25%+10%×) of P.ATK to enemies within 3 tiles. Before attacking, inflicts 1+ stacks of [Crush]. Tiles passed during Charge become [Frosty] for 2 turns.

[Auxiliary Passive], effect: the character's exclusive skill can store half of [Overkill DMG] (not exceeding 300% of HP). After attacking with the exclusive skill, if the target survives or enemies within 2 tiles of the character survive, the stored value is evenly distributed as DMG to those enemies.

skills.name: Yield or Ruin
desc: (Piercing DMG) [NRG Cascade]. Teleports in front of an enemy and deals [Piercing DMG] equal to (50%+20%×) of P.ATK. Before attacking, dispels 1+ [Buffs] and inflicts 1+ stacks of [Crush].

For every 2  consumed by this skill, additionally inflicts 1 random [Debuff] on the target from: [Stunned], [⊘Active Skills], [⊘Passive Skills], [⊘Reaction Skills] (Stunned lasts 1 turn; other effects last 2 turns).
If the target is defeated, refunds the consumed .

skills.name: Mounting Dominance
desc: (Passive) When casting skill [Yield or Ruin] or [Quaking Roar], for each stack of [Intimidate], adds an additional 1 to the  count, and [Piercing DMG] is increased by 10%.

skills.name: Ceaseless Wrath
desc: (Passive) When [Intimidate] reaches 3 stacks, after casting skill [Yield or Ruin] or [Quaking Roar], if actual NRG consumed is no less than 7, automatically triggers [Ironclad Will] effect.

skills.name: War-Tempered Form
desc: (Reaction) Gains [Block]. When attacked from any direction, 100% chance to trigger [Block], and DMG taken is additionally reduced by 10% when Blocking.
Can Block [Magical Attacks] and [AoE Attacks]. When Blocking such attacks, DMG taken is additionally reduced by 30%.

skills.name: Tenacity
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack from a [Counter Role] character, the DMG taken is decreased by 25%.

skills.name: Thunderbolt Roar
desc: (Passive) Skill [Ironclad Will] recovers an additional 2 NRG. After triggering or casting [Ironclad Will]: grants all allies within 3 tiles of the character [Regeneration III], [▲ATK II], and all [Level 2 DMG Buffs]; inflicts [▼ATK II] and all [Level 2 DMG Debuffs] on enemies within range. All effects last 3 turns.
All attacks from the character will not cause [Crush] to be removed.

skills.name: I Am the Law
desc: (Support) Consumes 3 stacks of [Intimidate]; grants other allies within 3 tiles of the character [Absolute Aegis], [▲P.DEF III], [▲M.DEF III], and [Percentage DMG Reduction V] for 3 turns. Can be used up to 1 time per battle.
When the [HP Threshold] effect in [Trait] is triggered, this skill's available uses are reset. Can be reset up to 1 time per battle.
[Auxiliary Passive], effect: Increases max HP by 20%. Automatically triggers 1 time at the start of the battle without consuming available uses.

skills.name: Evasion Break Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 80% of P.ATK and inflicts [Evasion] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 80% of P.ATK and inflicts 5 stacks of [Crush] after attacking.

skills.name: Tundra Raider
desc: (Passive) Increases ATK by 10%. After attacking, can move 2 additional tiles.
Does not consume Movement when passing through [Frosty] tiles, up to 2 tiles per round.

skills.name: Heart of the North
desc: (Passive) After engaging in combat with an enemy, the character recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
If the character or the target is on a [Frosty] tile when engaging in combat, additionally recovers 1 NRG. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

basic.name: Slash
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Tranquil Stance
desc: (Support) Selects a direction. Inflicts [▼P.DEF II] and [⊘Reaction Skills] on all enemies in a semicircular area of 4 tiles directly in front for 2 turns; gains 3 stacks of [Sheathed Stance] and [Basic Resistance], lasting until the start of the next turn; also gains [▲ATK II], [▲Crit II], [▲P.DEF II], and [▲M.DEF II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Coiled Edge

desc: (Healing) Heals other allies within 3 tiles around the character, restoring 10% HP and 2 NRG.

skills.name: Scorching Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% magical DMG and inflicts [Scorch] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Bang!
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Beryl deals physical DMG equal to 80% of her M.ATK. There is a 30% chance to inflict [Stunned] for 1 turn.

skills.name: BOOOOOM!
desc: (Magical DMG) Beryl cannot move before performing this skill. She attacks any enemies within 2 tiles 5 times, with hits randomly divided amongst those within range. Every hit deals 30% [Fire] [AoE DMG] to all enemies within 1 tile of the target, with a 50% chance of inflicting [Scorch].

skills.name: First Aid
desc: (Healing) Single-target healing. Heals 80% HP.

basic.name: Slash
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Resplendent - Gale Engraving
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects any tile within 5 tiles in a cross-shaped range and performs [Charge]. Then locks onto the nearest enemy (within 5 tiles in a cross-shaped range of the target) and deals 80% AoE DMG to all enemies in a straight line extending 5 tiles from that target.

If the force-selected target already has [Sword Mark], the attack range changes to a 5-tile horizontal row centered on the target, and triggers the [Personality] effect that inflicts [Sword Mark], based on the character's facing.
[Associated Passive]. Effect: Before casting a non-[Instant] skill or Basic Attack, increases ATK by 30% until the end of the turn.

skills.name: Resplendent Swordglow
desc: (Leader's Aura) For all allies in battle with the faction [The Aggression of Fire], increases ATK by 10%, DEF by 20%, and DMG and Piercing DMG by an additional 15%. Against enemies with [Sword Mark] or enemies that have triggered [Crossed Gleams], DMG and Piercing DMG increase by another 15%.
[Diona] additionally gains the following effect: Before battle, gains [▲ATK III], [▲P.DEF III], and [▲M.DEF III] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Cross of Conviction
desc: (Passive) During the current turn, if 2 types of [Sword Mark] are inflicted on the same enemy, then when [Crossed Gleams] is triggered on them, ATK increases by 60%.

skills.name: Resplendent - Starshield
desc: (Physical DMG) Teleports to the Designated Terrain tile, then deals 50% AoE DMG to adjacent enemies and gains [Global Assist III] for 1 turn.
Can be cast outside the skill's range on any location within a 1-tile radius of another ally (CD increases by 1 turn for every 3 tiles beyond the range).
After casting, gains 10 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 1 turn; for every 3 [Piety], gains 1 additional stack.

[Associated Passive]. Effect: When [Preempt] is triggered, [Piety] increases by 10 (up to 1 time per round). After gaining [Defensive Ward], if it has at least 20 stacks, gains [Stellar Ward] until the start of the next turn.

skills.name: Resplendent - Sunpiercer
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a direction, deals 80% AoE DMG to enemies within the area of effect in front, and knocks enemies on both sides of the area 1 tile toward the center line.
Also triggers the effect in [Trait] that inflicts a [Sword Mark], guaranteed to be the type the target is missing.
If the target already has a [Sword Mark] before attacking, retains the [Sword Mark] inflicted by this attack after triggering [Crossed Gleams].

skills.name: Resplendent - Swordguard
desc: (Reaction) Increases DEF by 40% and grants [Block] and [Daunting Preempt].
Can also block magical attacks and [AoE] attacks. When attacked from any direction, has a 100% chance to trigger [Block], and DEF is additionally increased by 40% while blocking.

When [Daunting Preempt] is triggered (up to 2 times per round), deals half the DMG of [Basic Attack]. If the target is defeated by [Preempt] or [Crossed Gleams] is triggered, the number of Preempts available in the current round increases by 1, up to 2 additional times per round.

skills.name: Front Defense
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack from the [front], the DMG taken is decreased by 30%.

skills.name: Lone Gleam Upon the Mark
desc: (Passive) When attacking, if the target already has a [Sword Mark] in the same direction, inflicts a [Sword Mark] in the other direction. Final DMG of [Crossed Gleams] triggered this way is reduced by 50%.
If this effect is triggered by [Preempt], the final DMG reduction of [Crossed Gleams] changes from 50% to 20%, and final DEF increases by 50% during this battle.

skills.name: Resolve
desc: (Passive) Immediately recovers 5% HP when the character is defeated. Can be activated up to 1 time per battle.

skills.name: Critical Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% physical DMG and increases Crit by 15% before attacking.

skills.name: Moonslash
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. If the character is in a straight line with the target, deals DMG to all enemies within 4 tiles directly in front. Deals 100% physical DMG to the first target, with final DMG reduced by 50% for each subsequent target. If not in a straight line, deals 100% physical DMG to the target.

skills.name: P.DEF Command
desc: (Aura) Increases P.DEF by 30% for other allies within 2 tiles around the character.

skills.name: Devout Faith
desc: (Passive) When the character's [Piety] is greater than or equal to 10, increases ATK by 15% and DEF by 30%.

basic.name: Energy Wave
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% Magical DMG.

default.name: Healing Spell
desc: (Healing) Heals the target by 100% of M.ATK and dispels 1 [debuff] on the target.

skills.name: Light of Judgement
desc: (Magical DMG) Single-target attack. Deals 140% DMG. After attacking, heals the ally with the lowest HP percentage in battle for 50% of the character's M.ATK.

skills.name: Inner Light
desc: (Support) [Instant] Selects 1 ally target, then restores 1 NRG to all allies within 3 tiles around the target. The character can not be targeted.

skills.name: Thorns of Mercy
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects a direction and deals Piercing AoE DMG equal to 90% of M.ATK to enemies within a 3×6 area; then heals allies in the area for 50% of M.ATK and grants them 1 stack of [Defensive Ward], [▲ATK II], [▲DMG II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Light of Love for All
desc: (Healing) Heals all allies within 4 tiles of the character for 30% of M.ATK and grants them 4 stacks of [Defensive Ward], [▲ATK II], [▲DMG II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns; then prepares for 1 turn, after which heals allies in range for 70% of M.ATK. Gains [Extra Effect] during preparation.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle, allies in range gain 3 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Endurance Activation
desc: (Reaction) When receiving healing, gains [DMG Reduction II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Undying Glimmer
desc: (Reaction) After taking DMG, if HP is below 50%, heals self for 100% of M.ATK and gains 10 stacks of [Defensive Ward] (lasting 2 turns). Cooldown: 3 turns after triggering.

skills.name: Radiant Truth
desc: (Support) [Instant] The character gains [Radiant Truth].
[Auxiliary Passive]: Before actively healing, dispels 2 random [Debuff] from the target; before actively attacking, inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Blossoming Mercy
desc: (Healing) [Instant] Heals all allies within 2 tiles of the target tile for 40% of M.ATK and grants them [▲P.DEF II] and [▲M.DEF II] for 2 turns.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Increases max HP and healing received by 15%. When casting [Light of Love for All], other allies in its range gain an additional 4 stacks of [Defensive Ward] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Holy Light Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals Piercing AoE DMG equal to 40% of M.ATK to all enemies within 1 tile of the target, then heals the 1 ally with the lowest HP within 4 tiles of the character for 40% of M.ATK.

skills.name: Merciful Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% magical DMG and increases the effect of the next healing skill by 15%, lasting for 2 turns.

skills.name: Light Bestowed
desc: (Passive) After actively healing, grants allies [▲Crit II], [▲Crit DMG II] and 1 stack of [Defensive Ward]; all effects last 2 turns.
Gains an aura: "Papal States" allies within 4 tiles of the character gain an additional 20% Crit and 10% Crit DMG, and gain [Piercing Bonus - Crit].

skills.name: Field
desc: (Aura) Decreases [AoE DMG] taken by all allies within 3 tiles around the character by 25%.

basic.name: Slash
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Path of Redemptive Suffering
desc: (Physical DMG) Leaps to the target location and casts the skill [Sword of Judgment].
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle or after using [Sword of Judgment], gains [▲Move I], [▲ATK III] and [DMG Reduction III] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Radiant Tempering
desc: (Support) [Channel] [Instant] While channeling, enhances [Sword of Judgment]: for each point of [Light of a Thousand Prayers], its DMG multiplier increases by 3% and its Crit by 0.5%, stacking up to 50 points; however, [Light of a Thousand Prayers] decreases by 50 at the start of the action.

enh.name: Radiant Tempering
desc: (Support) [Channel] [Instant] While channeling, enhances [Sword of Judgment]: for each point of [Light of a Thousand Prayers], its DMG multiplier increases by 4% and its Crit by 1%, stacking up to 50 points; however, [Light of a Thousand Prayers] decreases by 50 at the start of the action.

skills.name: Sin-Revealing Light
desc: (Passive) Before [Sword of Judgment] attacks, inflicts [Judgment] and [Vulnerable I] on the target for 2 turns.
[Sword of Judgment] deals 10% more DMG to enemies with [Judgment].

enh.name: Sin-Revealing Light
desc: (Passive) Before [Sword of Judgment] attacks, inflicts [Judgment] and [Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns.
[Sword of Judgment] deals 20% more DMG to enemies with [Judgment].

skills.name: Revelation - Final Judgment
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a tile and places [Revelation - Final Judgment], which descends after the character's 7th action ends (the current action counts as the 1st), dealing 777% AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of every odd-numbered action, accumulates 1 use of this skill (starts at 0).
When casting this skill, inflicts [Judgment] (until the end of battle) and [▼Move II] on enemies in range; the character gains [▲ATK I]. All effects last 2 turns.

enh.name: Revelation - Final Judgment
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a tile and places [Revelation - Final Judgment], which descends after the character's 7th action ends (the current action counts as the 1st), dealing 777% AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of every odd-numbered action, accumulates 1 use of this skill (starts at 0).

When casting this skill, inflicts [Judgment] (until the end of battle), [Straight Curse], [Vulnerable II], [▼Bound Sight II] and [▼Move II] on enemies in range; the character gains [▲ATK II] and [▲Crit II]. All effects last 2 turns.

skills.name: Revelation - Seventh Trumpet
desc: (Support) Makes every [Revelation - Final Judgment] descend immediately.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Whenever a [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends, this skill's effect triggers automatically.
After casting this skill or [Sword of Judgment], reduces the cooldown of [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 2 turns.

enh.name: Revelation - Seventh Trumpet
desc: (Support) Makes every [Revelation - Final Judgment] descend immediately.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Whenever a [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends, this skill's effect triggers automatically.
After casting this skill or [Sword of Judgment], reduces the cooldown of [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 3 turns.

skills.name: Sin-Purging Blade
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 70% physical AoE DMG to all enemies within 1 tile of the target. After attacking, gains [Light of a Thousand Prayers] equal to 25% of the number of [Pious Blessing] the character has (at least 15).

enh.name: Sin-Purging Blade
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 70% physical AoE DMG to all enemies within 1 tile of the target. After attacking, gains [Light of a Thousand Prayers] equal to 25% of the total [Pious Blessing] of all allies (at least 25).

skills.name: Hour of Answered Prayers
desc: (Support) [Instant] Consumes 100 [Light of a Thousand Prayers] so that the next [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends immediately after being placed.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Every 3 action starts, accumulates 1 use of [Revelation - Final Judgment].

enh.name: Hour of Answered Prayers
desc: (Support) [Instant] Consumes 100 [Light of a Thousand Prayers] so that the next [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends immediately after being placed.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Every 2 action starts, accumulates 1 use of [Revelation - Final Judgment].

basic.name: Slash
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Spear Soul - Darkstar Piercing Formation
desc: (Piercing DMG) [Instant] Selects any tile in a cross within 6 tiles of the character and performs a [Precise Charge] (can pass through; collision DMG taken by the character is reduced by 100%), dealing 50% DMG to enemies on the path and on both sides, inflicting 2 stacks of [Wound] (2 turns) and knocking them back 1 tile (in the charge direction). After attacking, gains 20 stacks of [Killing Intent].
[Auxiliary Passive]: After a [Charge], Movement increases by 2 tiles (until the end of the action), and gains [▲ATK II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Furious Roar
desc: (Passive) Before being attacked, dispels 1 [Buff] from the attacker and inflicts [▼ATK I] on them for 2 turns.

skills.name: Charge Pursuit
desc: (Physical DMG) [Instant]. Charges at 1 enemy within a cross-shaped range around the character, dealing 30% DMG. Gains immunity to [Preempt].

skills.name: Transgressors Shall Fall
desc: (Passive) When attacked, if there are enemies in the 3×4 area in the attacker's direction, performs a [Daunting Counter], dealing Piercing AoE DMG equal to 60% of P.ATK to enemies in the area; before countering, inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II] on the targets for 2 turns. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round (extra triggers by consuming [Counter Fervor]). When equipped with [Unwavering Spearpoint], this skill's ATK increases by 35%.
After actively attacking, gains [DMG Reduction II] (2 turns) and inflicts [Taunted] on the target for 1 turn (up to 2 targets if several are hit).
For each [Specific Defensive Buff] the character has, DEF increases by an additional 2%, up to 30%.

skills.name: Spear Soul - Lone Rider Against Thousands
desc: (Piercing DMG) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 100% of P.ATK to all enemies within 3 tiles of the character. Before attacking, consumes [Killing Intent]: every 10 stacks consumed increase the DMG multiplier by 10% (up to 100 stacks), and inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II], [⊘Passive Skills] and [⊘Reaction Skills] for 2 turns.
[Auxiliary Passive]: After actively attacking with a non-Instant skill, if this skill is not on cooldown, it is cast automatically; the character then suffers [Lone Rider - Exhausted] (2 turns).

skills.name: Imposing Might
desc: (Reaction) Increases max HP by 20%. When attacked by an enemy within 2 tiles of the character, reduces DMG taken by 30%.

When attacked by an enemy, if the attacker's total ATK is less than 250% of the character's total DEF, deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 40% of the character's P.ATK to the attacker. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.

skills.name: Hardening
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack, the DMG taken is decreased by 8%. After being attacked, the character gains [DMG Reduction II] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Unwavering Spearpoint
desc: (Passive) Increases max HP by 40%. Before being attacked, inflicts [Taunted], [▼ATK II] and [▼DMG II] on the attacker for 2 turns. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.
When attacked by a target affected by [Control], reduces DMG taken by 30%.
Has [Resolve]: when triggered, recovers 70% HP. Cooldown: 4 turns.

skills.name: Blood Oath Chains
desc: (Decision) Selects to use [Blood Oath - Hunt] or [Blood Oath - Guard]; using either skill puts both on cooldown.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the end of a charge, teleports targets with a [Blood Oath] effect next to the character and removes that effect.

skills.name: Sealing Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 80% of P.ATK. Before attacking an [Injured] enemy, inflicts [⊘Passive Skills] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Blood Spear Thrust
desc: (Basic Attack) Selects a tile and deals [Piercing AoE DMG] equal to 60% of P.ATK to all enemies within 3 tiles straight ahead, and gains 10 stacks of [Killing Intent].

[Auxiliary Passive]: After attacking with a [Basic Attack] or a non-Instant [Extra Skill], reduces the cooldown of the character's active [Class Skills] by 1 turn. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

skills.name: Co-Defense
desc: (Passive) For each ally within 2 tiles of the character, DEF increases by 10%, up to 40%.

skills.name: Valiant Breakthrough
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects any [Empty tile] in a cross within 3 tiles of the character, charges there (ignoring obstacles) and deals 120% [AoE DMG] to enemies in a 3×3 area in the target direction.
After attacking, gains [▲P.DEF III] and [▲M.DEF III] for 2 turns.

basic.name: Straight Shot
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% Physical DMG.

default.name: Venom Fang Bloom
desc: (Physical DMG) Attacks all enemies within 3 tiles of the character 2 times; each hit deals 40% physical DMG and inflicts 2 stacks of [Deadly Poison] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Serpent Shadow Step
desc: (Support) [Instant] Teleports behind an enemy, steals 2 NRG from the target and inflicts [⊘NRG Recovery] (2 turns); the character then gains [Serpent's Vanishing] (2 turns) and [Trickery - Exposed] (4 turns).

[Auxiliary Passive]: While having an [Invisibility] effect, before casting an attack skill, inflicts [NRG Block I] and [NRG Backlash] on the enemy, and on each hit applies the first one it does not have yet among [Bleed], [Ignition], [Minor Frostbite] and [Scorch]; if it has all of them, inflicts 1 stack of [Deadly Poison] and 1 stack of [Infection] (all these effects except [Infection] last 2 turns).

skills.name: Omen Plague
desc: (Debuff) Selects a tile and applies this effect 2 times to all enemies within 3 tiles of the target: inflicts the first one it does not have yet among [Bleed], [Ignition] and [Frostbite] (2 turns); if it has all of them, inflicts 1 stack of [Deadly Poison] (2 turns) and 1 stack of [Infection].

[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle and of every battle round that is a multiple of 3, inflicts 3 types of [Omen Plague] on all enemies in battle, triggered before they are hit by the next matching skill.

[Bleed]: applied before being hit by a [Sand] or AoE skill. [Ignition]: applied before being hit by a [Fire] or single-target skill. [Frostbite]: applied before being hit by an [Ice] or piercing skill.

skills.name: Shadowscale Ambush
desc: (Physical DMG) Teleports to the target tile, then casts [Venom Fang Bloom] at no cost; if a character is on the target tile, swaps positions with it before attacking.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Effects triggered by Basic Attacks or by this skill do not reveal the character from [Serpent's Vanishing].

skills.name: Shadow of the Mad Serpent
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a tile and deals physical AoE DMG equal to 70% of total ATK to all enemies within 3 tiles of the target.

The sum of the HP-loss multipliers (per stack) of the target's [Deadly Poison] and [Omen] effects is added to the skill multiplier ([Infection] counts its actual stacks); after the attack, 1 stack each of [Deadly Poison] and [Omen] effects is dispelled.
For each type of [Omen] on the target, this skill's final DMG increases by 15%, up to 75%.
Before attacking, inflicts [Vulnerable II] and [Piercing Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns; with 5 types of [Omen], these become [Vulnerable III] and [Piercing Vulnerable III] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Molting Escape
desc: (Reaction) When hit by any attack, performs a [Total Evasion]. Triggers once per round.
After taking DMG, if [Dying], gains [Serpent's Vanishing] (1 turn) and [Regeneration III] (3 turns). This effect then has a 7-turn cooldown.

skills.name: Entrapping
desc: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack, the DMG taken is decreased by 8%. Steals 2 random [Attribute Buffs] from the target.

skills.name: Apostasy
desc: (Passive) While the character's [Piety] is -10 or lower, increases ATK by 15% and DEF by 30%.

skills.name: Devouring Fang
desc: (Passive) When attacking, increases ATK by 8% for each stack of [Deadly Poison] on the target and each NRG it is missing, up to 40%. After attacking, inflicts [NRG Drain I] for 2 turns.
When [Shadow of the Mad Serpent] is used, all [Deadly Poison] on the target is added to the skill multiplier, and all [Deadly Poison] is dispelled after the attack.
When any enemy in battle with [Deadly Poison] or [Infection] is defeated, the character recovers 15% HP and 1 NRG.

skills.name: Bone-Eating Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Single-target attack. Deals 100% physical DMG, removes 2 NRG from the target and inflicts 1 stack of [Deadly Poison] (2 turns) and 1 stack of [Infection].

skills.name: Invigorating Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 100% physical DMG and additionally recovers 1 NRG.

skills.name: Toxin Vial
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects a tile and deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 10% of their HP to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target, and inflicts 1 stack of [Deadly Poison] (2 turns) and 3 stacks of [Infection].

skills.name: Weapon Eroder
desc: (Piercing DMG) Single-target attack. Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 30% of the target's HP and then inflicts [▼ATK II] for 2 turns.

basic.name: Energy Wave
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% Magical DMG.

default.name: Life Devourer
desc: (Magical DMG) Single-target attack. Deals 150% DMG. After attacking, gains 45% [Life Steal].

skills.name: High Spirits
desc: (Passive) While [Healthy], increases ATK by 10%.

skills.name: Dark Ripple
desc: (Magical DMG) Deals 70% [AoE DMG] to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target and inflicts [⊘Passive Skills] and [⊘Reaction Skills], lasting for 2 turns.

skills.name: Conversion of the Masses
desc: (Support) [Instant] Selects a tile: allies in a cross within 3 tiles of the target (3 tiles wide) gain 1 stack of [Gospel] and [Pontiff's Grace] (2 turns); enemies in range suffer [▼ATK II], [▼DMG II] and [⊘Buff] for 2 turns and 2 stacks of [Gospel], and 2 [Buff] are dispelled from them. The 4 closest enemies with [Devout Follower] additionally gain [Zealous Follower] (2 turns).
Finally, all enemies in battle with [Devout Follower] turn toward [Constantine] and trigger the [Flagellant Atonement] effect.

skills.name: Divine Descent - Hearts as One
desc: (Magical DMG) Selects a direction and deals 160% AoE DMG to the 3×5 area straight ahead (including the character's row). Before attacking, inflicts [▼M.DEF II] on the targets; after attacking, inflicts 2 random [Level 2 Debuff], plus [Straight Curse] if the target is [Dying]. All effects last 2 turns.

With 80 stacks of [Divine Insight], this skill costs no NRG, its DMG multiplier against enemies with [Gospel] or [Devout Follower] increases by an additional 80%, and it performs an [Area Replication] on every unit in battle with [Devout Follower] (same direction as the caster). After attacking, removes 80 stacks of [Divine Insight] and [Devout Follower] from all units.

skills.name: Radiant Return
desc: (Reaction) Reduces DMG taken by 15%, plus 1% per stack of [Divine Insight], up to 15% more. After being attacked, inflicts 1 stack of [Gospel] on the attacker.
Has [Resolve]: when triggered, recovers 100% HP, returns to the position held at the start of the action and gains [Radiant Return]. Can be triggered up to 3 times per battle.
While having [Radiant Return], if there are no allies in battle at the start of the action, the character is immediately defeated.

skills.name: Endure
desc: (Reaction) Takes 50% less [DoT].

skills.name: Radiance Upon the World
desc: (Magical DMG) Selects a tile and deals 100% AoE DMG to enemies in a cross within 3 tiles of the target (3 tiles wide); after attacking, gains 25 stacks of [Divine Insight], plus 5 per target hit (up to 15 more); finally inflicts 1 stack of [Gospel] on all characters in range.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of the action, gains [▲ATK II] and [▲DMG II] for 2 turns.
Whenever any character in battle gains [Devout Follower], the character gains 1 stack of +6% DMG, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Dispelling Strike
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 80% magical DMG and dispels 2 [buffs] on the target.

skills.name: Divine Judgment
desc: (Basic Attack) Selects a tile, deals 80% magical AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target and inflicts 1 stack of [Gospel]. After attacking, the character gains 20 stacks of [Divine Insight].

skills.name: Blessing
desc: (Support) [Instant]. Single-target healing. Restores 25% HP. Before healing, if the target is [Unharmed], additionally grants [▲DMG II] and [▲M.DEF II] for 2 turns.
If the target belongs to the〈Papal States〉faction, additionally increases their [Piety] by 5.

skills.name: Light of Gathered Faith
desc: (Magical DMG) Selects a tile and deals 180% AoE DMG to all enemies within 1 tile of the target; before attacking, inflicts [▼M.DEF III] and [Vulnerable III] for 2 turns. For each character in battle with [Devout Follower], DMG increases by 10%, up to 60%, then their [Devout Follower] is removed.
With 40/80 stacks of [Divine Insight], consumes that many stacks to increase the DMG multiplier by 40%/80%.
